retrievalProfile.description: A group of figures in stylized futuristic attire standing on a road that leads into a massive spiral galaxy.
triggerTerms: galaxy backdrop with vanishing point road
excludeWhen: urban street settings without cosmic elements

recipe.visualDefinition: A symmetrical composition featuring six male figures in elaborate, high-contrast futuristic costumes. They stand on a dark asphalt road with a single yellow line that recedes into a sharp vanishing point. Above them, a luminous blue and white spiral galaxy dominates the sky, creating a halo effect around the central figures.
coreVisualRelationships: Figures arranged in a horizontal line across the foreground
Road providing a strong vertical perspective toward the center
Spiral galaxy acting as a circular frame for the group
Glowing accents on clothing and shoes mirroring the starlight
coreInvariants: The central vanishing point of the road must align with the center of the galaxy spiral.

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Six full-body figures occupy the lower two-thirds of the frame, scaled to appear heroic and prominent.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The bright white core of the spiral galaxy at the top center.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes follow the road upward to the galaxy, then circle around the figures' faces and detailed costumes.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Deep blue cosmic voids in the upper corners provide breathing room for the complex central imagery.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Deep cobalt and electric blue (background and atmosphere)
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Bright white and cyan (galaxy light and highlights)
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Multicolor costume elements including red, yellow, and purple
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the figures' clothing contrasts with the atmospheric gradients of the space background.

letterConstructionRules: Uniform stroke weight with sharp, pointed terminals
characterSpecificRedesigns: A and K feature triangular negative space
S is constructed from three distinct horizontal bars
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Stand-alone display lettering to maintain sci-fi aesthetic.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the wide, technical feel of 80s sci-fi typography.
Provides the necessary squareness and geometric structure.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate an airbrushed painting of six men in 80s futuristic costumes standing on a road that recedes into a giant blue spiral galaxy.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add custom wide, angular metallic lettering across the top edge with extreme tracking.

verificationChecks: Do the shoes have a glowing effect?
Is the lettering ultra-wide and geometric?

postGenerationChecks: Ensure figures have distinct, stylized outfits
Confirm the spiral galaxy has a bright core
recipe.reuseFormula: 80s Sci-Fi Airbrush + Spiral Galaxy + Vanishing Point Road + Futuristic Group Portrait
